r13_contract.comparisonModel: (vii) For ships which are assigned the Polar Class PC6 or PC7, and equipped with bulbous bows, the design ice forces on the bow are to be determined according to I2.3.2.1 (iv). In addition, the design forces are not to be taken less than those given in I2.3.2.1 (iii), assuming fa = 0.6 and AR = 1.3.

test_cases.rationale: PC6 bulbous bow: method-(iv) candidate governs and final design force equals the greater candidate.
PC7 bulbous bow: method-(iii) floor governs and final design force respects the floor.
Non-PC6/PC7 bulbous bow is outside the source applicability branch.
PC6 without a bulbous bow is outside the source applicability branch.
Applicable bulbous-bow case uses shape coefficient other than the mandated 0.6 floor assumption.
Applicable bulbous-bow case uses load-patch aspect ratio other than 1.3 for the method-(iii) floor.
Final design force is below the method-(iii) floor.
Method-(iv) candidate governs but final design force does not equal the governing value.
Applicable case is missing the method-(iii) comparison-force operand.
Method-(iv) force has the wrong unit.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
